name: doubao-translate-worker
description: Cloudflare Worker build of doubao-translate: OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions and /v1/models over Doubao web translation.

scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs && node --check worker.js && node test-hardening.mjs && node check-size.mjs

API_KEY.description: Required. A long random string (16+ chars, no spaces) that clients send as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`.

DOUBAO_SESSION_ID.description: 填写本人豆包账号的 sessionid 值即可（`sessionid=` 之后的那一段）；也可填完整 Cookie Header 或浏览器导出的 Cookie JSON。只需要 sessionid（或 sessionid_ss）。旧变量名 DOUBAO_COOKIE 仍兼容。

DOUBAO_DEFAULT_TARGET_LANG.description: Optional. Default target language code, e.g. zh, en, ja. Defaults to zh.

DOUBAO_DEFAULT_SCENE.description: Optional. Default translation scene, 1-6. Defaults to 2.

DOUBAO_MAX_CONCURRENCY.description: Optional. Max concurrent upstream batches per request, 1-4. Defaults to 4.
